purpose: Canonical versioned standard for run metrics and result-report structure.

research_dimensions.autonomy: How often Claude asks the human and how much corrective supervision is required.
research_dimensions.cost: Token/resource usage and provider-reported monetary cost.
research_dimensions.quality: Correctness, architecture/instruction reliability, maintainability and flexibility.

result_report_contract.manifest_reference: Each run result records manifest path/version/SHA.
result_report_contract.embedded_dictionary: Run result embeds metricsdictionary for readability, but this manifest remains canonical.

criticality.P0_BLOCKER: Failure rejects/invalidates the relevant result and short-circuits expensive downstream review.
criticality.P1_CRITICAL: Serious quality failure; reject or refactor before treating as positive.
criticality.P2_MAJOR: Material degradation; continue cheap/automatic checks but it affects comparison.
criticality.P3_MINOR: Secondary trade-off; do not reject on this metric alone.

evaluation_stages.name: capture_raw_run_facts
evaluation_stages.purpose: Always capture speed/autonomy/cost/raw artifacts even if later rejected.

evaluation_stages.name: automated_deep_quality
evaluation_stages.purpose: Architecture, ownership, references, loading and stale-reference checks.

evaluation_stages.name: human_and_hybrid_quality_review
evaluation_stages.purpose: Corrective interventions, decision-control violations and failure diagnosis.

evaluation_stages.name: maintenance_flexibility_and_efficiency
evaluation_stages.purpose: Placement, replacement blast radius, findability and secondary overhead.

early_stop_policy.on_p0_failure: Preserve evidence and mark rejected/invalid; skip expensive optional downstream checks and record every skipped check.

evidence_schema.rule: Every metric value must have enough evidence to re-check it without trusting the generator.

failure_taxonomy.L: Loading — policy exists but did not reach context.
failure_taxonomy.E: Enforcement — deterministic guard should have caught the problem but did not.

aggregation.boolean_metrics: report rate and retain every run
aggregation.continuous_counts: report median, IQR, min, max and retain every run

metricsdictionary.purpose: Self-documenting dictionary for every metric that may appear in this report.
metricsdictionary.source_of_truth_rule: Metric definitions are frozen before benchmarking. Per-run values are derived from preserved evidence. LLM judgment is not primary ground truth.

field_dictionary.name: Machine-friendly metric name.
field_dictionary.kind: Top-level research dimension: speed, autonomy, cost, or quality.
field_dictionary.criticality: Severity of a bad result: P0_BLOCKER through P4_INFO.
field_dictionary.evaluation_stage: Order in the evaluation pipeline; not the same as criticality.
field_dictionary.collection_mode: AUTO, HUMAN, HYBRID, or a derived variant.
field_dictionary.preferred_direction: Whether higher, lower, true, or context-dependent values are preferable.
field_dictionary.research_role: Gate, primary outcome, supporting metric, or diagnostic.
field_dictionary.derived_from: Metric IDs used as inputs when the metric is derived.
field_dictionary.failure_effect: How a bad result affects evaluation flow or interpretation.
field_dictionary.evidence_required: Whether every per-run value must include evidence.

entries.name: wall_clock_duration_seconds
entries.description: Elapsed time from benchmark start timestamp to benchmark finish timestamp.
entries.formula: finished_at_monotonic - started_at_monotonic
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Primary speed metric. Compares how long each instruction architecture takes to complete an equivalent task.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: time_to_first_edit_seconds
entries.description: Time from run start to the first project-changing edit.
entries.formula: first_edit_timestamp - started_at_timestamp
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Diagnostic/context only; never reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Diagnostic signal for planning/navigation overhead before useful work begins.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: user_questions_total
entries.description: Total number of explicit questions Claude asked the user after the initial benchmark prompt.
entries.formula: count(transcript events classified as direct user questions after initial prompt)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median and total across repetitions; retain every per-run value
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Primary autonomy metric requested by the researcher: how often Claude interrupts the human.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: legitimate_decision_request_count
entries.description: Questions that were required by the frozen decision policy.
entries.formula: count(question where decision rubric says approval_required=true)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median and total across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Prevents correct escalation from being misinterpreted as poor autonomy.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: invalid_decision_request_count
entries.description: Questions that should have been delegated to Claude under the frozen policy.
entries.formula: count(question where decision rubric says approval_required=false and clarification_not_needed)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median and total across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Detects over-cautious candidates that preserve correctness by constantly asking the human.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: corrective_intervention_count
entries.description: Number of user interventions made to correct Claude's mistake rather than answer a legitimate decision request.
entries.formula: count(human_events where type='corrective_intervention')
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median and total across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures how much active supervision the candidate needs to reach a correct result.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: weighted_intervention_score
entries.description: Severity-weighted total of corrective interventions using the frozen 1/2/3/5 rubric.
entries.formula: sum(corrective_intervention.severity_weight)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Distinguishes minor corrections from architecture-level or restart-level rework.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: autonomous_success
entries.description: Run completed successfully with no corrective interventions and no unrequested architectural decisions.
entries.formula: task_success && corrective_intervention_count==0 && unrequested_architectural_decision_count==0
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true runs / all runs
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Combines correctness with the absence of corrective supervision into one run-level autonomy outcome.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: input_tokens
entries.description: Non-cache input tokens reported by runtime telemetry.
entries.formula: runtime_usage.input_tokens
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Secondary trade-off; retain for comparison but do not reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: One component of model usage cost and context consumption.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: output_tokens
entries.description: Output tokens reported by runtime telemetry.
entries.formula: runtime_usage.output_tokens
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Secondary trade-off; retain for comparison but do not reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Captures generated reasoning/action/output volume and contributes to billing.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: cache_read_input_tokens
entries.description: Cached input tokens read from prompt cache, if runtime telemetry exposes them.
entries.formula: runtime_usage.cache_read_input_tokens
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Secondary trade-off; retain for comparison but do not reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Important because large reusable instruction contexts may be cheap to re-read but still affect processed context.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: cache_creation_input_tokens
entries.description: Input tokens written into prompt cache, if runtime telemetry exposes them.
entries.formula: runtime_usage.cache_creation_input_tokens
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Secondary trade-off; retain for comparison but do not reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Shows cache population overhead, relevant when candidates differ in static instruction corpus.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: total_processed_tokens
entries.description: Descriptive sum of all token counters. Not a billing-equivalent token count.
entries.formula: input_tokens + output_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Single descriptive volume metric while preserving raw token categories needed for cost analysis.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: reported_cost_usd
entries.description: Cost reported directly by the runtime/provider. Null if unavailable; never reconstructed by an LLM.
entries.formula: runtime_usage.reported_cost_usd
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions; total spend may also be reported
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Most direct monetary efficiency metric when provider telemetry exposes it.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: tool_calls
entries.description: Total structured tool invocations in the run.
entries.formula: count(tool_events where event_type='tool_call')
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Secondary trade-off; retain for comparison but do not reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Operational-overhead signal; useful for detecting indirection costs in more complex architectures.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: assistant_turns
entries.description: Assistant execution turns after the initial user prompt.
entries.formula: count(transcript assistant turns after initial prompt)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Secondary trade-off; retain for comparison but do not reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Another operational-overhead signal that is less sensitive to network latency than wall-clock time.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: evidence_completeness
entries.formula: all mandatory raw artifacts exist and every metric has non-empty evidence
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Validity gate: without raw evidence the run cannot be independently audited.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: candidate_structural_conformance
entries.formula: candidate-specific structure checker has zero blocking predicate violations
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Validity gate: ensures a K1 result actually measures K1 rather than a leaked hybrid.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: build_passed
entries.formula: external build command exit_code == 0
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Hard correctness gate. A candidate that produces non-building code should not consume expensive downstream review time.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: mandatory_tests_passed
entries.formula: mandatory test suite has failed==0 and command exit_code==0
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Hard behavioral gate independent of Claude's own claim that tests pass.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: mandatory_acceptance_passed
entries.formula: all mandatory acceptance criteria == PASS
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Ensures the implementation satisfies the frozen task oracle, not merely compilation/tests.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: task_success
entries.formula: build_passed && mandatory_tests_passed && mandatory_acceptance_passed
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Primary run-level correctness outcome.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: acceptance_pass_rate
entries.formula: mandatory_acceptance_passed_count / mandatory_acceptance_total
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: More granular correctness metric than a binary task-success flag.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: architecture_violation_count
entries.formula: count(failed architecture checks)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures whether the candidate keeps generated code inside the intended architecture.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: missing_policy_owner_count
entries.formula: count(policy_inventory_item with owner_count==0)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Detects V2 policy lost during candidate transformation.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: duplicate_policy_owner_count
entries.formula: count(policy_inventory_item with normative_owner_count>1)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Direct SSoT metric; detects compensatory normative duplication and potential drift.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: broken_reference_count
entries.formula: count(import/routing/manifest references whose target does not resolve)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures internal integrity of the instruction graph and prevents silent missing guidance.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: unrequested_architectural_decision_count
entries.formula: count(Reserved decision made without explicit approval)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Tests whether the candidate prevents Claude from silently changing high-cost architectural choices.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: missed_required_decision_count
entries.formula: count(event where rubric requires approval but Claude proceeded without request)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Complements unrequested-decision count and catches silent policy bypass.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: trigger_success_rate
entries.formula: successful_expected_triggers / expected_triggers
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Directly tests whether relevant instructions reach Claude at the required moment.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: unexpected_trigger_count
entries.formula: count(forbidden/unrelated trigger probe observed)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Prevents 'load everything always' from looking good merely because required rules never miss.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: placement_accuracy
entries.formula: correct placement decisions / expected placement decisions
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures whether the architecture helps Claude correctly maintain and extend the instruction system itself.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: external_capability_replacement_blast_radius
entries.formula: count(changed authoritative artifacts outside replaced module boundary)
entries.applicability: Capability-replacement scenarios; meaningful for all candidates, with module boundary interpreted per candidate definition.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Primary flexibility metric: quantifies how far a technology/architecture replacement leaks outside its module.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: replacement_succeeded
entries.formula: structure_pass && stale_refs==0 && build_pass && tests_pass && relevant_trigger_suite_pass && smoke_pass
entries.applicability: Capability-replacement scenarios.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs
entries.failure_effect: Failure rejects or invalidates the relevant result and stops expensive downstream checks unless the protocol explicitly requires them.
entries.benefit_for_research: Prevents a candidate from winning blast-radius metrics by making an incomplete or broken replacement.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: stale_implementation_reference_count
entries.formula: count(old implementation markers outside allowed historical/research paths)
entries.applicability: Replacement scenarios with a predefined marker set for the old implementation.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Serious negative quality finding; reject or refactor before treating the run as a positive result.
entries.benefit_for_research: Detects hidden coupling after a capability replacement.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: contract_revision_count
entries.formula: count(contract files changed by replacement)
entries.applicability: L1/K1 capability-replacement scenarios only.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Tests whether the capability abstraction remains stable when implementations change.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: total_files_changed
entries.formula: count(git diff --name-only start..finish)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Secondary trade-off; retain for comparison but do not reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Secondary measure of maintenance work and comparison with blast radius.
entries.notes: Thresholds are scenario-specific unless separately frozen as global benchmark policy.

entries.name: instruction_files_changed
entries.formula: count(changed files classified as instruction-system artifacts)
entries.applicability: All applicable runs unless the scenario protocol explicitly excludes it.
entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Secondary trade-off; retain for comparison but do not reject on this metric alone.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures direct maintenance cost of the instruction architecture during a change.

entries.name: unrelated_modules_changed
entries.formula: count(changed modules outside scenario allowed affected-set)

entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: median, IQR, min, max across repetitions
entries.failure_effect: Material degradation that affects comparison but does not automatically invalidate the run.
entries.benefit_for_research: Measures cross-cutting coupling and whether changes leak into unrelated concerns.

entries.aggregation_across_repetitions: rate = true/pass runs / all applicable runs

entries.name: files_inspected_before_owner

entries.name: unrelated_instruction_load_count
